review_notes:
I read all of CapVal.lean (lines 1–90). Its proofs are short:
- capVal_sum is `unfold capVal; rw [map_sum, map_sum]`.
- capVal_smul is `unfold capVal; rw [map_smul, map_smul, smul_eq_mul]`.
- capVal_zero uses omegaFun_cap_zero and Functor.Monoidal.ε_η.
- parameter_capVal is a direct wrapper around parameter_model.

capVal_sum and capVal_smul share the same two-step linearity pattern. That is routine unfolding plus existing API lemmas, so it is not nontrivial repeated reasoning.

The ε P.ω ≫ η P.ω = 𝟙 step in capVal_zero also appears in CircleModel.lean, StdTransport.lean, OmegaTransport.lean and OmegaTensorPower.lean. Each occurrence is a one-line application of Functor.Monoidal.ε_η, so a shared lemma would only be a thin wrapper. The surrounding contexts differ too. I did not find a substantial repeated block that would justify a new shared lemma. I did not open the other files in full, so some uncertainty remains about any larger duplication elsewhere.
